title: Non-Perturbative Construction and Non-Triviality of 4D Euclidean Phi4 Quantum Field Theory
exact_target: Can the proposed four-dimensional quartic scalar theory be constructed as a genuinely non-Gaussian continuum field, outside the class already ruled out by the cited triviality theorem?

sources.citation: M. Aizenman, H. Duminil-Copin, Ann. of Math. 194(1):163-235, 2021.
